articles.summary: Owens Corning (NYSE: OC), a branded building products leader, today reported third-quarter 2026 results. Reported Net Sales of $2.5 Billion , a 7% Decrease from Prior Year Generated Net Earnings Margin of (10)% and Adjusted EBITDA Margin of 20% Delivered Diluted EPS of $(3.15) and Adjusted Diluted EPS of $2.44, which excludes the impact of Non-Cash, Pre-Tax Impairment Charges of $476 Million related to the Doors Business Produced Operating Cash Flow of $813 Million and Free Cash Flow of $622 Million Returned $337 Million to Shareholders through Dividends and Share Repurchases; Reduced Debt by $299 Million “During the quarter, challenging residential market conditions were further impacted by a second consecutive year of weak storm activity and rapidly rising transportation and input material costs. Despite these pressures, our team demonstrated disciplined commercial and operational execution, delivering a resilient margin and strong cash flow,” said Chair and Chief Executive Officer
articles.title: Owens Corning Announces Third-Quarter 2026 Results
